units.name: U1 Fresh ammonia pump
units.purpose: Raise liquid fresh ammonia to the reactor-loop pressure and overcome plant pressure losses.

units.name: U2 Feed-recycle mixer
units.purpose: Combine pressurized fresh ammonia with recovered liquid ammonia recycle.

units.name: U3 Feed-effluent recuperator
units.purpose: Recover reactor-effluent sensible heat to warm and partly vaporize the mixed ammonia feed.

units.name: U4 Ammonia vaporizer and trim heater
units.purpose: Complete ammonia vaporization and provide controlled feed temperature with electric trim heat when recuperation is insufficient.

units.name: U5 Electric reaction furnace
units.purpose: Supply feed superheat and the endothermic reaction duty to the externally heated reactor tubes.

units.name: U6 Packed-bed ammonia decomposition reactor
units.purpose: Convert ammonia over the selected literature catalyst to nitrogen and hydrogen at optimized temperature and per-pass conversion.

units.name: U7 Ammonia condenser
units.purpose: Cool recuperator effluent and condense residual ammonia using cooling water.

units.name: U8 Ammonia knockout drum
units.purpose: Separate condensed ammonia from the hydrogen-nitrogen product gas.

units.name: U9 Ammonia recycle pump
units.purpose: Return recovered liquid ammonia to the feed mixer and restore recycle-loop pressure loss.

units.name: U10 Hydrogen PSA
units.purpose: Recover high-purity hydrogen from nitrogen, residual ammonia, and unrecovered hydrogen.

units.name: U11 Hydrogen product compressor
units.purpose: Compress purified hydrogen from reactor-loop pressure to the battery-limit delivery pressure.

units.name: U12 Utilities and offsites
units.purpose: Provide cooling-water circulation, electrical distribution, controls, and safe handling of the nitrogen-rich PSA tail gas.

streams.name: recuperated_NH3

streams.name: vaporized_NH3

included: U4 Ammonia vaporizer and trim heater

catalyst_regeneration.excluded: No cross-catalyst regeneration protocol is supported by the selected experiments; catalyst replacement and life are costed instead, avoiding an invented zero-duty regenerator.
